    Profile

    Dilga is a soldier of the National Regular Knight Faction of Envylia. When it comes to combat and drills, he's strict both to himself and others, but after the hours, he doesn't spare words of gratitude and advice towards his subordinates, so he's highly trusted. His main complex is that children tend to get scared of him because of his fierce appearance.

    Origin: Envylia
    Gender: Male
    Height: 177cm
    Weight: 102kg
    Birthday: May 5
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Thunderous Emperor
    Likes: Biceps
    Hobbies: Muscle training
    Illust: 大盛よしを
    CV: 小山剛志
